WITH active_assignments AS ( SELECT a.prj_id,a.dev_id,d.vndr_ptnr_id,r.cust_ptnr_id FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj r ON r.prj_id=a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE r.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD') AND a.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today} ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.ptnr_id,p.ptnr_no,p.ptnr_se_cd,p.ptnr_nm,p.biz_reg_no,p.ceo_nm,p.indty_cd,p.chrg_nm,p.chrg_tel_no, CASE WHEN p.ptnr_se_cd='VEND' THEN NULL ELSE p.txinv_email_addr END AS txinv_email_addr,p.use_yn, k.cd_nm AS "kindName",i.cd_nm AS "industryName", CASE WHEN p.ptnr_se_cd='CUST' OR p.acnt_no IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE b.cd_nm || ' …' || right(p.acnt_no,4) END AS "paymentAccount", CASE WHEN p.ptnr_se_cd='VEND' THEN NULL ELSE ( SELECT count(DISTINCT projects.prj_id) FROM ( SELECT r.prj_id FROM prj.prj r WHERE r.cust_ptnr_id=p.ptnr_id AND r.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD') UNION SELECT a.prj_id FROM active_assignments a WHERE p.ptnr_se_cd='BOTH' AND a.vndr_ptnr_id=p.ptnr_id ) projects ) END AS "projectCount", (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.dev_id) FROM active_assignments a WHERE (p.ptnr_se_cd IN ('CUST','BOTH') AND a.cust_ptnr_id=p.ptnr_id) OR (p.ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND','BOTH') AND a.vndr_ptnr_id=p.ptnr_id)) AS "assignmentPeopleCount" FROM mst.ptnr p LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl k ON k.cd_grp_id='PARTNER_KIND' AND k.dtl_cd=p.ptnr_se_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl i ON i.cd_grp_id='INDUSTRY' AND i.dtl_cd=p.indty_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl b ON b.cd_grp_id='BANK' AND b.dtl_cd=p.bank_cd
) rows ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT ptnr_id,ptnr_no,ptnr_se_cd,ptnr_nm,biz_reg_no,ceo_nm,indty_cd,chrg_nm,chrg_tel_no,rmrk_desc,use_yn, CASE WHEN ptnr_se_cd='VEND' THEN NULL ELSE txinv_email_addr END AS txinv_email_addr, CASE WHEN ptnr_se_cd='CUST' THEN NULL ELSE bank_cd END AS bank_cd, CASE WHEN ptnr_se_cd='CUST' THEN NULL ELSE acnt_no END AS acnt_no, CASE WHEN ptnr_se_cd='CUST' THEN NULL ELSE dpstr_nm END AS dpstr_nm FROM mst.ptnr WHERE ptnr_id=#{id}
SELECT ptnr_id,ptnr_no,ptnr_se_cd,ptnr_nm,biz_reg_no,ceo_nm,indty_cd,chrg_nm,chrg_tel_no,rmrk_desc,txinv_email_addr,bank_cd,acnt_no,dpstr_nm,use_yn FROM mst.ptnr WHERE ptnr_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT ptnr_nm FROM mst.ptnr WHERE biz_reg_no=#{biz}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.cd_dtl d JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=d.cd_grp_id WHERE d.cd_grp_id=#{group} AND d.dtl_cd=#{code} AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y')
mapper.update: UPDATE mst.ptnr ptnr_se_cd=#{value.ptnr_se_cd}, ptnr_nm=#{value.ptnr_nm}, ceo_nm=#{value.ceo_nm}, indty_cd=#{value.indty_cd}, chrg_nm=#{value.chrg_nm}, chrg_tel_no=#{value.chrg_tel_no}, rmrk_desc=#{value.rmrk_desc}, txinv_email_addr=#{value.txinv_email_addr}, bank_cd=#{value.bank_cd}, acnt_no=#{value.acnt_no}, dpstr_nm=#{value.dpstr_nm}, updated_by=#{actor} WHERE ptnr_id=#{id}
